Class ChangeListenerRegistry

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.jdbc.notification.ChangeListenerRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.context.processor.ExecutableMethodProcessor<ChangeListener>
@Internal @Singleton public final class ChangeListenerRegistry extends Object implements io.micronaut.context.processor.ExecutableMethodProcessor<ChangeListener>
Collects methods annotated with ChangeListener and groups them by datasource.

Micronaut discovers the methods through ExecutableMethodProcessor. The registry records each method's bean definition and entity type without creating listener bean instances or opening database connections.

ChangeListenerDataSourceValidator uses the collected metadata to validate datasource configuration. ChangeListenerRegistrationHandler registers the methods with the selected notification provider during application startup.
